description_en: Apparently erected in the 20th century, the exact origins of this Śiva temple remain elusive due to the absence of historical records.Situated north of the pathway within the Gorakhanātha complex, leading to the Viśvarūpa Mandira, this brick temple stands on three plinth levels. The bell-shaped roof, once adorned with a now-lost finial, shelters the main body of the temple, serving as its sanctum. Accessible through a southern entrance embellished with a stone archway (toraṇa), featuring a central carving of Chepu, a mythical water creature, the temple's exterior walls on the west, north, and east contain small stone windows.Within the sanctum resides a stoneśivaliṅga, representing Śrīmānamukteśvara Mahādeva. The temple remains perpetually closed, hindering any investigation into potential additional statues within the sanctum. A small Bhairava mask is embedded on the southern outer wall adjacent to the entrance. Elements such as a depiction of Śiva’s animal mount Nandī in the west and a stone trident (triśūla) in the north, customary for temples of this nature, are also present. Regrettably, the statue of Kāmadeva, originally positioned southwest of the temple, has already been stolen.The absence of inscriptions at the site shrouds the identity of the donor and the year of the temple's construction in mystery. During the Rāṇā period, it was a usual tradition for royals to constructśivālayas (lit. abode of Śiva), often naming them after a living person suffixed with "bhakteśvara" or in memory of a deceased family member suffixed with "mukteśvara." Although the temple's name, Śrīmānamukteśvara, suggests construction by an individual in memory of a deceased family member, the specific dedication remains unclear. Despite uncertainties about its origins, the architectural characteristics point to a construction date in the 20th century (G. Ṭaṇḍana VS 2053, p.347).Notably, this temple does not witness daily worship or any other religious activities.
description_ne: ईशाको २० औं शताब्दीमा निर्माण गरिएको यस शिवालय कसको नाममा कहिले बनाइएको थियो भन्ने कुरा थाहा पाइँदैन ।पशुपति क्षेत्रमा रहेको गोरखनाथ परिसरबाट विश्वरूप मन्दिर जाने बाटोमा यो मन्दिर रहेको छ । इँटा प्रयोग गरी बनाइएको घण्टाका शैलीको यो शिवालयमा राखिएको गजूर हराइसकेको छ । यस शिवालयको दक्षिणमा एउटा ढुङ्गाको ढोका राखिएको छ । उक्त ढोकामाथि छेपु अङ्कित ढुङ्गाको तोरण राखिएको छ । त्यसै ढोकालाई मन्दिरको प्रवेशद्वारको रूपमा प्रयोग गरिन्छ । शिवालयको पश्चिम, उत्तर र पूर्वमा ढुङ्गाका साना झ्याल राखिएका छन् । गर्भगृहभित्र श्रीमानमुक्तेश्वर शिवलिङ्ग स्थापना गरिएको छ । शिवालयको ढोका बन्द हुनाले गर्भगृहको भित्तामा कुनकुन देवता स्थापना गरिएका छन् भन्ने कुरा जान्न सकिएन । मन्दिरको दक्षिणपट्टि भित्तामा भैरवको मुखाकृति राखिएको छ । त्यस्तै शिवालयको पश्चिममा नन्दी र उत्तरमा ढुङ्गाको त्रिशूल स्थापना गरिएको छ । शिवालय बाहिर दक्षिण-पश्चिममा कामदेवको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको भएपनि चोरी भइसकेको छ ।यो शिवालयको स्थापनाबारे कुनै अभिलेख राखिएको पाइँदैन । शिवालय कसको नाममा कहिले बनाइएको थियो भन्ने कुरा थाहा पाइँदैन । शैलीको आधारमा यो ईशाको २० औं शताब्दीमा निर्माण गरिएको देखिन्छ (G. Ṭaṇḍana VS 2053, p.347) ।यस शिवालयमा नित्यपूजा लगायत अन्य कुनै पूजाहरू सञ्चालनमा छैनन् । शिवालयको ढोका सधैँ बन्द नै रहने गर्छ ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)
references: REFERENCES Ṭaṇḍana, Govinda. Paśupatikṣetrako Sāṃskṛtika Adhyayana . 1st ed. Vol. 1. Kāṭhamāḍauṃ: Jharendra Śamśera Ja. Ba. Ra. and Mañju Rāṇā, 2053.
